label: All methods are fresh derivative ablations; no historical recovery claim
evidence: Repeated all-data CV progress evidence, not an untouched test
grid: 25 Hz zero-order hold, recording origin, integer source timestamps; no clock repair
filter: Cubic least squares on previous nine samples (current excluded), derivatives evaluated at current grid time
warmup: First valid feature at grid index 40 = 1600 ms; no padding. Derivatives valid from index 9.
baseline: Fresh raw ZOH morphology using the same statistics and windows; not historical morphology recovery
normalization: No recording-wide normalization; StandardScaler fit per training fold only
ranking: descending minimum, mean, maximum fold AUC
continuous: Inherited 40ms anchors; decision anchor+880ms; threshold .5; rising edges; 1500ms refractory; one-to-one match onset+680..1280ms
pooled: Concatenate held-out appearances; repeats counted repeatedly
selection: No feature selection, tuning, neural models, calibration, or test adaptation
